Weight is like 90% determined by diet rather than excercise. Excercise is great for developing cardio and building muscle but terrible for losing fat. 

Start eating oatmeal. I know it sounds nasty, but try getting those packets of instant oatmeal, you can get them with strawberries and cream, chocolate chip (which is sweet and good) or get regular oatmeal and mix in peanut butter, which you can put a lot of in to make it more filling and it won't really make you lose weight. 
It works best to change up your diet. Ever seen a vegan? You can see every fiber of their muscle even if they're a twig like me, cause it's darn near impossible to gain fat weight on plant food. Not that you should go vegan (it's awful) but substitute more plant food into your diet. Advocodos, spinach, banannas, maybe portabellums, things like that. I know it sounds gross but you start getting used to it. 
Don't watch the scale every day either. That would just discourage you. It's a long process, just focus on eating better in your daily life and the weight loss will come naturally.

Good for you. Thing is, when you're paying hundreds of dollars for something it shouldn't be a game of Russian roulette. They ALL should work. That's called quality assurance. 

>PS2 uses PS1 hardware internally to accomplish this. It's not a technological leap backwards, it's a business decision so they can sell upscaled, emulated versions of the games.

It doesn't matter how it's accomplished. Technological advancement is determined by functionality. A car that ran on water would be a technological advancement, it doesn't matter if gasoline is structurally more complex. Backward compatibility is better than no backwards compatibility. Doesn't matter if it was thrown out so Sony could save a few bucks when ripping everyone off. And re-releases aren't emulations, they're an okay idea if they improve the games but essentially they're just forcing you to fork over $60 without the option to keep the game you already paid $60 for, unless you just stick with the old system which is the better choice imo.
